verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's MFA docs list hardware keys, biometrics, certificates and JumpCloud Go (a 'hardware-protected and phishing-resistant' passwordless method) alongside push and TOTP. Separately, they say MFA can be enforced across SAML/OIDC apps and that conditional access can revoke access based on network or device compliance. However, no evidence shows a policy that requires specifically FIDO2 or phishing-resistant factors for selected sensitive apps, and the FIDO2/WebAuthn and passkey standards are never named. Missing for 10: explicit FIDO2/WebAuthn and passkey support, per-app policy to require phishing-resistant factors only, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
